title: Yellowed Roasted Croatian Cheese Casserole
description: A comforting Croatian dish featuring roasted cheese and a unique blend of flavors, including Thai fish sauce, this casserole is perfect for a cold winter's night. It is a nut-free-friendly option for those with dietary restrictions.

ingredients.name: croatian cheese
ingredients.notes: such as Paški sir or Zagorski sir

instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat and sauté the chopped onions until they are translucent.
Add the minced garlic to the skillet and cook for an additional minute, stirring constantly to prevent burning.
In a large bowl, combine the cooked onions and garlic, shredded cheese, deep-fry-tod, thai fish sauce, paprika, salt, and black pepper, and mix well.
Transfer the mixture to a 9x13 inch baking dish and roast in the preheated oven for 25 minutes, or until the top is golden brown and the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Remove the casserole from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before serving.
Serve the casserole hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
Leftovers can be refrigerated for up to 3 days and reheated in the oven or microwave.
